If a string ends with a backslash (or has backslashes not preceding a tag), they are not processed by the `if escapes:` block and are instead yielded as literal text at the very end of the function via `yield position, markup[position:], None`. However, this is actually correct behavior for most cases, but if the trailing backslash was intended to be part of an escape sequence or should be handled consistently with how literal backslashes are handled elsewhere, it might be an issue. from rich.markup import render
